question: ‘Nirmala’ was a fiction novel written by:
solution:
The correct answer is__** Munshi Premchand**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Munshi Premchand, born as Dhanpat Rai on July 31, 1880, in Lamhi, near **Varanasi,** is considered one of the greatest Hindi and Urdu writers.
 
• He wrote over 300 short stories and 14 novels, including famous works like** Godaan, Nirmala, and Gaban.**<
